"title":"Review insurance policy details",
"text":"Complete the following checks:\n- Confirm policy type, owner, insured, beneficiary, and premium payer.\n- Review current death benefit, cash value, surrender value, riders, and premium schedule if applicable.\n- Check whether beneficiary designations align with Paige Lanternmoss's estate and family goals.\n- Identify pending premium increases, lapse risk, term expiration, conversion options, or long-term care benefit triggers.\n- Request the most recent in-force illustration or policy statement when needed.\n- Note any tax, estate, liquidity, or coverage gaps to discuss with the advisor.\n- Document whether outside insurance, legal, or tax professionals should be consulted.\nThe policies are Silver Marmot Life term policies for Paige (1M, through 2028) and Darin (750K, through 2030). "priority":"medium",
"dueDate":null,
"assigneeId":null,

},
{
"templateId":"b91c5012-f119-507f-91de-d78d8599cb42",

"text":"Review the proposed charitable transfer using these criteria and collect supporting evidence:\n- Confirm intended recipient is a qualified charity or eligible donor-advised fund sponsor.\n- Confirm asset type, estimated value, cost basis if available, holding period, and whether appreciated securities are involved.\n- Confirm source account registration and authority to give transfer instructions.\n- Verify delivery instructions, including recipient name, tax identification details if provided securely, custodian delivery method, and any special purpose or designation language.\n- Check whether the gift should be coordinated with Paige Lanternmoss's tax advisor for deductibility, AGI limits, bunching strategy, or required minimum distribution treatment.\n- Confirm whether Paige Lanternmoss needs an acknowledgment letter, gift receipt, or confirmation for tax records.\n- Evidence to collect: Paige Lanternmoss's authorization, current position or cash balance, charity delivery instructions, custodian form or portal confirmation, and final transfer confirmation.\nPaige proposes gifting appreciated Copper Firefly Systems shares to Marzipan Meadow Arts Fund. Gather the share details, valuation, and delivery instructions.",
"priority":"medium",
"dueDate":"2025-11-21",
"assigneeId":null,

},
{
